Container.Name: energy-ingest
Container.Overview: Imports Green Button utility XML (electricity and natural gas, including solar/NEM exports) into an embedded MariaDB database and serves it to Home Assistant through an authenticated local API. Drop XML files into the imports folder; they are imported and matched to your meters automatically. The Home Assistant API token is generated on first start at /config/secrets/api_token. Keep port 8080 on your LAN only.
Container.Requires: See docs/INSTALL_UNRAID.md. Allow up to 60 seconds to stop so the embedded database shuts down cleanly.

Config.Name: API port
Config.Description: Authenticated HTTP API used by Home Assistant. Do not forward this port from your router.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database files, generated credentials, API token and import state. Back this up with the container stopped.

Config.Name: XML imports
Config.Description: Drop Green Button *.xml exports here. Files are read, never modified.

Config.Name: Utility name
Config.Description: Your utility, e.g. SDG&E. Required for automatic import.

Config.Name: Electric meter name
Config.Description: Friendly name for your electricity meter. Leave empty if you have none. For solar/NEM, grid consumption goes here; set the solar export meter to track energy sent back to the grid separately.

Config.Name: Electric meter number
Config.Description: Optional utility meter number from your bill. Stored privately; never logged.

Config.Name: Solar export meter name
Config.Description: Optional. For solar/NEM: a separate meter for electricity your panels send back to the grid. Use it as Return to grid in the Home Assistant Energy Dashboard. Leave empty without solar.

Config.Name: Gas meter name
Config.Description: Friendly name for your natural gas meter. Leave empty if you have none.

Config.Name: Gas meter number
Config.Description: Optional utility meter number from your bill. Stored privately; never logged.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Your utility's time zone. Natural gas daily totals use it.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns appdata files and runs the database and API.

Config.Name: Import source label
Config.Description: Label for how the XML is obtained.

Config.Name: Automatic meter matching
Config.Description: Match imported data to the single configured meter of each type. Set false to match manually with engy-admin.

Config.Name: Import check interval
Config.Description: Seconds between checks of the imports folder (minimum 30).
